offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures heat tracing and process heating equipment for industrial plants, commercial facilities and rail operators. It also engineers, installs and maintains heating systems for customers.

primary_products.value: electric and steam heat tracing systems; industrial process heaters; steam and hot-water boilers; heating controls and monitoring systems; rail switch heaters

primary_services.value: system engineering and design; installation; commissioning; field maintenance and repair

customer_segment.value: B2B: Industrial plant operators, engineering and construction contractors, commercial facility operators and freight railroads; B2G: Public rail and transit agencies that use track and switch heating systems

end_markets.value: oil and gas; chemicals and petrochemicals; industrial manufacturing; power generation; rail transportation

revenue_model.value: product sales: Heat tracing equipment, process heaters, boilers, controls and replacement parts; project or contract: Custom heating systems with engineering, equipment supply and installation; service fees: Commissioning, troubleshooting, maintenance and repairs
revenue_model.category: product sales; project or contract; service fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Builds heaters, boilers and controls from electrical and mechanical components for facility operators and contractors; service provider: Uses site and process specifications to design, install and maintain heating systems for facility operators

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Latin America, Europe, Middle East, Africa and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: Heat tracing, process heaters, boilers, controls, rail heating and field services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Technical sales teams serving facility operators and engineering and construction contractors; distributors / dealers: Industrial electrical and heating equipment distributors; agents / brokers: Independent manufacturers’ representatives for boiler and heating equipment
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; agents / brokers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Hazardous-location heaters and pressure equipment are subject to electrical safety codes, ATEX requirements and ASME boiler standards.

notes: It is unclear whether public transit agencies buy directly or through contractors.
